name: in-outer-projection-joined-input
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a+1 IN (SELECT i.x+o.k+j.enabled-1 FROM inner_rows i JOIN inner_rows j ON j.k=i.k WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1 AND j.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: row-in-outer-projection-joined-input
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE (o.a+1,o.b) IN (SELECT i.x+o.k,j.y FROM inner_rows i JOIN inner_rows j ON j.k=i.k WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1 AND j.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: in-outer-projection-joined-input-without-filter
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a+o.k IN (SELECT i.x+o.k FROM inner_rows i JOIN inner_rows j ON j.k=i.k) ORDER BY o.id;

name: in-outer-projection-joined-input-collation
sql: SELECT o.id FROM typed_outer o WHERE o.k IN (SELECT (CASE WHEN o.grp>0 THEN i.k ELSE o.k END) COLLATE NOCASE FROM typed_inner i JOIN typed_inner j ON i.rowid=j.rowid WHERE i.grp=o.grp) ORDER BY o.id;

name: not-in-outer-projection-joined-input
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a+1 NOT IN (SELECT i.x+o.k+j.enabled-1 FROM inner_rows i JOIN inner_rows j ON j.k=i.k WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1 AND j.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: row-not-in-outer-projection-joined-input
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE (o.a+1,o.b) NOT IN (SELECT i.x+o.k,j.y FROM inner_rows i JOIN inner_rows j ON j.k=i.k WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1 AND j.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: not-in-outer-projection-joined-input-without-filter
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a+o.k NOT IN (SELECT i.x+o.k FROM inner_rows i JOIN inner_rows j ON j.k=i.k) ORDER BY o.id;

name: not-in-outer-projection-joined-input-collation
sql: SELECT o.id FROM typed_outer o WHERE o.k NOT IN (SELECT (CASE WHEN o.grp>0 THEN i.k ELSE o.k END) COLLATE NOCASE FROM typed_inner i JOIN typed_inner j ON i.rowid=j.rowid WHERE i.grp=o.grp) ORDER BY o.id;

name: in-outer-only-projection-joined-input
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a IN (SELECT o.a FROM inner_rows i JOIN inner_rows j ON j.k=i.k WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1 AND j.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: in-outer-projection-joined-input-keeps-duplicates
sql: SELECT o.k,o.a FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a+1 IN (SELECT i.x+o.k FROM inner_rows i JOIN inner_rows j ON j.k=i.k WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1 AND j.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.k,o.a;

name: not-in-outer-projection-joined-input-with-no-matches
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a NOT IN (SELECT i.x+o.k FROM inner_rows i JOIN inner_rows j ON j.k=i.k WHERE i.k=123456) ORDER BY o.id;

name: row-not-in-outer-projection-joined-input-disjunction
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE (o.a,o.b) NOT IN (SELECT i.x+o.k,j.y FROM inner_rows i JOIN inner_rows j ON j.k=i.k WHERE i.k<o.k OR j.y=o.b) ORDER BY o.id;
